t: You're at the site of New Wandsworth railway station, which has closed. It was opened on the 29th of March 1858 by the West End of London and Crystal Palace Railway, when the line was extended from Wandsworth to Pimlico. It closed on the 1st of November 1869, six years after Clapham Junction opened a short distance to the north, and Wandsworth Common station replaced it. James Lecky, an Anglo-Irish civil servant and musicologist, died here in 1890.
